risks.risk_description: Static review does not prove physical schema behavior, but preserves all authority boundaries.
risks.mitigation: Use static requirements and keep physical validation blocked until explicit non-productive target approval.

risks.risk_description: No migration-specific safe no-op tooling is currently verified.
risks.mitigation: Require explicit tooling evidence before any dry-run/no-op path.

risks.risk_description: A non-productive DB validation target would approach execution and must not be inferred.
risks.mitigation: Require separate explicit approval and target attestation before physical validation.

risks.risk_description: Blocking the path would delay readiness despite available migration and static review evidence.
risks.mitigation: Do not block; select static review only.
